title: Managed Database: portfolio usage eligibility
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database portfolio usage eligibility applies to database charge. Use posted portfolio usage subtotal to select the portfolio discount. Combine only holdings of this category owned by the same customer with the same legal billing entity and source period, even if some have since closed. No cross-entity or cross-category spending counts. The threshold comparison is inclusive. Portfolio discount applies only to primary service usage and only if no higher-priority price applies; it is neither a cash credit nor a deduction from ancillary service fees.

## Account measurement
The source period, a UTC calendar month; customer and legal billing entity match the proposed charge. Sum posted primary meter quantities net of meter reversal by holding, multiply each interval by its applicable standard tier unit rate and region factor without any discount or tax, and sum across this category. Exclude ancillary meters and never sum already discounted invoices.
